No economy, profiles, HTTP, all technologies or full-game rendering workload was loaded; no full-game FPS improvement claim.
Movement/collision/real-hit acceptance is instrumented engine evidence; camera screenshots were not used for visual acceptance.
Stable zero repeated native orders/path queries/coordinate corrections is not zero total AI or cached terrain cost.
Historical exploratory failed fixtures and earlier source hashes are excluded from final acceptance.
